The '''Muntuur stones''' were a famous set of seven stones, which were used to train [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]]. Inspired by the rock gardens within the ancient [[Gardens of T'alla/Legends|Gardens of T'alla]], the stones were a powerful meditation tool.

==Overview==
According to unverified legend, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ferleen Snee]] once lifted all seven of the stones high above his head using only [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and proceeded to have them whirling through the sky in an unprecedented display of [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> Regardless if the legend was true, the stones were nonetheless kept in the [[Kuddaka chamber]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]; here, Jedi could test their telekinetic ability by seeing how many stones they could lift simultaneously.<ref name="TJP" />

With each stone weighing at least five [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] each,<ref name="CSWE" /> and the heaviest stone weighing at over five metric tons,<ref name="GG9" /> merely jostling a stone was marked as an achievement by a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] being able to lift multiple stones at a time. Only masters of telekinesis were able to lift more than four at a time though; with [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] only being able to lift five after he passed seven hundred years of age, [[Fae Coven]] being able to lift six only after entering a deep and long meditation, and Ferleen Snee&mdash;if the legend was true&mdash;being the only recorded Jedi to lift all seven.<ref name="TJP" />
